name: Coneic Player
description: A Windows media player built on VLC, with a personal library, saved moments, study notes and smart collections.
features: Windows defaults and custom icons for 134 media formats
note: Development preview. Device and codec coverage varies; see the bundled validation notes.

name: Quranly PC
tagline: Make room for your daily practice.
description: Read the Quran, listen to recitations, save audio offline and continue your daily practice on Windows.
features: Optional account backup and playback resume
note: All app features are free. New online content requires a connection; optional AI answers use your own provider key.

name: Tooldeck
tagline: Small tools. A lot less friction.
description: 79 local PDF, image, video, audio, conversion and utility tools in a clean card library.
features: Merge, extract and rotate PDF pages
JSON, text, Base64 and URL utilities
QR codes, passwords and file hashes
note: Files are processed locally. Conversion limits are explained in each workspace.

name: Doc Cloud
description: A free, focused workspace for writing, editing and organizing your documents.
features: Rich text, pageless drafting and column previews
CSV mail merge and recipient previews
TOC snapshots and local document library
note: Expanded alpha. Continuous column preview, local mail merge and basic Office conversion. Advanced layout and hosted collaboration remain incomplete.

name: Sheet Cloud
tagline: A clearer view of your numbers.
description: A free spreadsheet workspace for formulas, tables, charts and everyday planning.
features: Persistent range charts and pivot summaries
Live formula Goal Seek and data tools
note: Expanded alpha. Static pivot summaries and persisted native charts; full Excel fidelity, VBA and hosted collaboration are not included.

name: Slide Cloud
description: A free local-first presentation editor with editable slides, templates, speaker notes, slideshow and basic PPTX exchange.
features: Editable tables, chart data, shapes and text
Speaker notes and same-window presenter console
Native backups and basic PPTX exchange
note: Expanded alpha. Presenter notes share the same window; no independent audience display. PPTX compatibility is partial; native slideshow effects do not round-trip through PowerPoint.

name: Canvas Cloud
description: A free local-first whiteboard for notes, diagrams, sketches and visual planning.
features: Editable tables, Kanban text and local replies
Native backups, SVG and PNG export
note: Windows alpha. Local annotations and boards; no live multiplayer, cloud sync or complete competitor parity.

name: BlueCloud Launcher
tagline: One home for your BlueCloud apps.
description: Discover, install, open and update BlueCloud apps from a single Windows library. No account needed to manage your apps.
features: One library for your BlueCloud apps
note: Alpha release. Updates use a signed release feed. Public Windows publisher signing is required before a stable release.
